snippet.title: ZOO PROTOCOL - OFFICIAL CINEMATIC TRAILER
snippet.description:
Zoo Protocol is a 1-5 player co-op sci-fi horror. You wake from cryosleep in an abandoned energy facility, and the system running the place has already put you on shift.

In Early Access on Steam now.
